property_summary: For any caller, calling proxiableUUID() on the correct implementation returns the constant ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT; the mutant returns a different value (zero) for some callers, so the returned bytes32 must equal ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT for all inputs (the mutant violates this).
change_summary: Return a different constant (zero) instead of ERC1967Utils.IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
